biggest_catch: Tiered bonus: you earn $200 only if you spend $1,000 in the first 90 days; $500-$999 in spend earns just $100. Never spend extra solely to chase the bonus. No annual fee, so the bonus is fully net of card fees - but the bonus is not awarded until 91-100 days from account opening.
catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the bonus; the $200 tier requires $1,000 in real spending within 90 days ($500+ earns only $100).
No annual fee per regions.com, so the full bonus is net of any card annual fee.
Applying for a credit card can involve a hard inquiry on your credit report.
If you carry a balance, interest (0% intro APR for 12 months on purchases, then 18.49% - 28.49% variable) can erase the bonus; pay in full each month.
The bonus is awarded 91-100 days from account opening - a ~3-month wait after meeting the spend.
Only new cardholders qualify; existing/previous account terms may exclude you - check eligibility when you apply.
